metadata.title: PolySwarm - Sandbox Outlook Attachment Detonation - Incident Triggered (Preview)
metadata.description: Preview: deploys and passes every local check, but has not yet been run against a live Exchange Online mailbox. Feedback to support@polyswarm.io. For every MailMessage entity on a Microsoft Sentinel incident, retrieves the message's attachments via the Office 365 Outlook connector and detonates each in the PolySwarm sandbox (CAPE or Triage), polling until complete or timeout and commenting verdict, score, malware family, MITRE ATT&CK techniques and a report link back to the incident. Defaults to your private PolySwarm community; refuses to submit to the public community unless AllowPublicCommunity is explicitly set. Never creates an incident.
prerequisites: A PolySwarm API key with sandbox access, stored as a secret in an Azure Key Vault.
The private PolySwarm community you want detonations to land in.
An Office 365 mailbox connection with permission to read the mail message referenced by the incident's Mail entity.

The PolySwarmSandbox_CL Data Collection Endpoint and Data Collection Rule deployed (Data Connectors folder - not owned by this playbook). This playbook is the only writer to that table: it POSTs one row per detonation attempt (including timeouts) via the Logs Ingestion API, since PolySwarm's own sandbox task list API does not carry verdicts.
postDeployment: 1. Assign the 'Microsoft Sentinel Responder' role on the resource group (or workspace) to this playbook's system-assigned managed identity.
2. Assign the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the Key Vault (named by the KeyVaultName parameter) to the same managed identity.

3. The 'Monitoring Metrics Publisher' role on the Data Collection Rule (DcrResourceId) is assigned automatically at deployment when create_role_assignment is true (default) and the deploying principal can grant RBAC roles on that DCR; otherwise set create_role_assignment to false and assign the role manually.
4. Authorize the Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Key Vault and Office 365 API connections if they show as unauthorized.
5. Attach the playbook to an automation rule so it runs on incidents with a Mail entity, or run it manually.

metadata.description: Name of the Logic App playbook resource.
Version string sent in the User-Agent header on every call to the PolySwarm API. Bump this when the solution version changes.

REQUIRED. Your PolySwarm private community name (for example a name your PolySwarm account admin gave you, not 'public' or 'default'). There is no default value on purpose: this playbook refuses to silently fall back to the public community. An attachment or URL submitted to the public community is visible to every other member of that community. To submit to the public community anyway, you must also set AllowPublicCommunity to true and pass 'public' here.

Set true only to explicitly allow a submission to the public community when Community is 'public' (or 'default'). Default false: the playbook terminates with no submission if Community resolves to the public community and this is false.

Sandbox provider slug, verified live against GET /sandbox/provider/list on 2026-09-23: 'cape' (tool cape_sandbox_v2) or 'triage' (tool triage_sandbox_v0). Re-check that endpoint before deploying - PolySwarm can add or retire providers, and the two report different score scales (triage: analysis.score 0-10; cape: malscore 0-1).

VM image slug for the chosen Provider, verified live 2026-09-23 against GET /sandbox/provider/list. Triage: android-11-x64 (FILE only), ubuntu-22.04-amd64, windows11-21h2-x64 (default; FILE and URL). Cape: win-10-build-19041 (FILE and URL). Must support the artifact type this playbook submits, or task creation fails.
Allow the sample outbound network access during detonation.

Minutes to poll the sandbox task before giving up and commenting a timeout with the task id and report link. Verified live timings: a triage URL detonation completed in under 3 minutes; a cape URL detonation took about 4.5 minutes. A file matching PolySwarm's known-good allowlist (observed live for the EICAR test file) returns immediately with no real detonation.
Name of the Azure Key Vault holding the PolySwarm API key. The playbook's managed identity needs the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on this vault - grant it after deployment (see postDeployment).
Name of the Key Vault secret holding the PolySwarm API key.
PolySwarm REST API v3 base URL.

Score at or above which the comment and PolySwarmSandbox_CL row report 'malicious'. Both providers were verified live to report on the same 0-10 scale (a live LockBit sample: cape_sandbox_v2.malscore 8.0, triage analysis.score 10 - an earlier draft wrongly assumed cape used a 0-1 scale from a benign URL's low malscore; corrected). Score = coalesce(report.malscore, report.analysis.score). A string because ARM templates have no float parameter type.

Score at or above which (and below MaliciousScoreThreshold) the comment and PolySwarmSandbox_CL row report 'suspicious'. Below this, 'benign'. A null score (no report - FAILED or a timeout) reports 'unknown'; a KNOWN_GOOD status reports 'known good' regardless of score.

Data Collection Endpoint URL for the PolySwarmSandbox_CL Log Analytics table's Logs Ingestion API pipeline (Microsoft.Insights/dataCollectionEndpoints resource's logsIngestion endpoint). Matches the 'dceLogsIngestionEndpoint' output of the Data Connectors infrastructure template that owns this table and its DCE/DCR - deploy that template first (not owned by this playbook).

Immutable id of the Data Collection Rule that transforms and routes rows into PolySwarmSandbox_CL, used in the Logs Ingestion API URL. Matches that template's 'dcrImmutableId' output. NOT the same value as DcrResourceId below - an immutable id is not a usable ARM resource id for RBAC scoping.
DCR stream name for the PolySwarmSandbox_CL table. Matches that template's 'streamName' output.

The Data Collection Rule's full ARM resource id (NOT its immutable id - two different identifiers for the same object; DcrImmutableId above is for the Logs Ingestion API URL, this is for RBAC scoping the role assignment below). Matches the Data Connectors template's 'dcrResourceId' output. Also used by PolySwarm-Sandbox-DefenderFile for the same role assignment.

If true (default), automatically assigns the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the DCR (DcrResourceId) to this playbook's managed identity, matching the Recorded Future Sandbox_StorageAccount reference pattern. Requires Owner or User Access Administrator on the DCR's scope to deploy; set false and grant the role manually if the deploying principal lacks that.

Initialize_sandbox_status.description: Top-level initialization required by Logic Apps (InitializeVariable is not allowed inside a scope). Reset to the same value at the point in the loop where the task's real starting status is known - see Reset_sandbox_status.

For_each_mail.description: Runs once per Mail entity on the incident. Gets the message by id with the Office 365 Outlook connector, lists its attachments and detonates each one in the PolySwarm sandbox, then comments the verdict, score, malware family, MITRE ATT&CK techniques and report link on the incident. The playbook never creates incidents.

List_attachments.description: Office 365 Outlook connector, by message id from the Microsoft Sentinel Mail entity (NetworkMessageId / InternetMessageId depending on the entity's populated field - use whichever the entity carries).

For_each_attachment.description: One sandbox submission per attachment on the mail message referenced by the incident's Mail entity.

Get_PolySwarm_API_key.description: Reads the PolySwarm API key from Key Vault via the playbook's managed identity. Never a deployment parameter.

Guard_community_is_not_public_unless_exp.description: Decisions locked #2: sandbox submissions default to the private community; public only by explicit parameter choice. Community has no ARM default (required parameter), and even when set to 'public' or 'default' the submission is refused unless AllowPublicCommunity is explicitly true.

Create_sandbox_task.description: Step 1 of 3, for the current mail attachment.

Upload_artifact_bytes.description: Step 2 of 3. The Office 365 'Get attachment' action below returns ContentBytes as base64; base64ToBinary decodes it before the PUT. No Authorization header - matches the verified upload_file() behaviour.

Finalize_sandbox_task.description: Step 3 of 3. Task id goes in the query string, community in the JSON body.

Reset_sandbox_status.description: Starts this loop iteration's polling clean. InitializeVariable cannot live here (Logic Apps only allows it at the top level of the workflow) - sandboxStatus is initialized once at the top of the workflow and reset to the real starting value here on every iteration.

Set_sandbox_status.description: HTTP 204 with an empty body means PolySwarm has no such task (not found). It is handled explicitly as NOT_FOUND, which ends the poll loop, and the empty body is never read.

Compose_next_sandbox_status.description: Computes the next value of sandboxStatus. Logic Apps does not allow a variable to be set from an expression that reads the same variable.

Build_summary.description: Builds the summary used for both the incident comment and the PolySwarmSandbox_CL row, from the last poll of the sandbox task. The score is on the 0 to 10 scale both sandbox providers use. Verdict rule, used everywhere: KNOWN_GOOD is 'known good'; no score is 'unknown' (this covers a failed task and a timeout); at or above MaliciousScoreThreshold is 'malicious'; at or above SuspiciousScoreThreshold is 'suspicious'; otherwise 'benign'.

Determine_outcome.description: Outcome category, used only to choose the incident comment's narrative text - the verdict value itself (Build_summary?['verdict']) is the same single rule in every branch and in the PolySwarmSandbox_CL row.

Send_to_PolySwarmSandbox_CL.description: Logs Ingestion API: one row per detonation attempt, keyed by TaskId. CompletedAt is this playbook's own observed-terminal timestamp (utcNow()) - the verified SandboxTask response shape has no server-provided completion time.

body.message:
PolySwarm sandbox detonation
Artifact: @{replace(replace(replace(replace(string(items('For_each_attachment')?['Name']), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"')}
Verdict: @{outputs('Build_summary')?['verdict']} (@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['score'], null), 'no sandbox score', concat('score ', formatNumber(outputs('Build_summary')?['score'], '0.0'), '/10'))})
Provider: @{outputs('Build_summary')?['providerSlug']} / @{outputs('Build_summary')?['vmSlug']}
@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['malwareFamilyList']), '', concat('Malware family: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(join(outputs('Build_summary')?['malwareFamilyList'], ', ')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
'))}@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['techniques']), '', concat('MITRE ATT&CK: ', join(outputs('Build_summary')?['techniques'], ', '), '
'))}Community: @{parameters('Community')}@{if(or(empty(parameters('Community')), equals(toLower(parameters('Community')), 'public'), equals(toLower(parameters('Community')), 'default')), ' (public: anyone with PolySwarm access can see this result)', ' (private)')}
Task id: @{outputs('Build_summary')?['taskId']}
@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['reportLink'], null), concat('PolySwarm report: sandbox task ', outputs('Build_summary')?['taskId'], ' (no public report link available for this submission)'), concat('PolySwarm report: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(outputs('Build_summary')?['reportLink']), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''))}

Add_success_comment_to_incident_unless_c.description: Microsoft Sentinel can answer 409 when several playbooks comment on one incident at once, even though the comment was saved. A 409 is left alone; any other failure posts the comment once more.

Guard_community_before_processing.description: Checked once before the loop, because Logic Apps cannot stop a run from inside a loop. Refuses to submit to the public community unless AllowPublicCommunity is true.

runError.message: Community parameter is empty, 'public' or 'default', and AllowPublicCommunity is false. Refusing to silently submit to the public community. Set Community to your PolySwarm private community name, or set AllowPublicCommunity to true to explicitly opt into a public submission.
